segments.text:
V. 37.
They ſhall look on him whom they have pierced—He was pierced by the Soldier's Spear. They who have occaſioned his Sufferings by their Sins (and who has not?) ſhall either look upon him in this World with penitential Sorrow; or with Terror, when He cometh in the Clouds of Heaven, Rev. i. 7.
